source.stem:
Aluminium is used to make containers for storing food.

Which property makes it suitable for this use?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Moon is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: The Moon does not emit its own light.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Earth sees only the illuminated part facing Earth -> the visible bright shape ch happens first, and that produces Sunlight illuminates half of the Moon.

intelligence.enrichment: The Moon keeps its shape and shines by reflected sunlight; phases are the changing shapes of the illuminated part visible from Earth. Sunlight illuminates half of the Moon -> Earth sees only the illuminated part facing Earth -> the visible bright shape changes. The learner correctly applies this rule: The Moon keeps its shape and shines by reflected sunlight; phases are the changing shapes of the illuminated part visible from Earth. The Moon's shape changes each night, and shadows or the Moon's own light make the changing shapes.
